title: Compilence public mathematical claims audit

edges.scope_note: Both belong to the public deterministic-semantic architecture; the semiring sufficiency status does not imply the ranking result.
Both concern formal guarantees stated for the public architecture; neither claim logically implies the other.
Structural refusal is presented as part of the same formal semantic system, but this edge records context only, not implication.

does_not_establish: This graph audits a narrow set of public mathematical formulations. VERIFIED_FALSE means the tested public wording is false under the stated minimal assumptions, not that the Compilence project as a whole is invalid. UNDER_SPECIFIED means the inspected public sources are insufficient for independent proof. Non-public specifications may add assumptions that change individual results.
